dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Hey look! It's our old pal, Liben!

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you two! Been a while, hasn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Wait, you know this guy too? Okay... I'm slowly starting to get why Boss Nef asked you to help me out...

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Ah, you must be the expo manager. Was there something you needed from me?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Nope, just checking in. You're just selling a few ordinary items, is that right?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Okay. I mean, we've got people selling toys this year, so why not...

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Hah, you seem confused. In the right environment, ordinary items don't have to fetch an ordinary price, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: I'm sure I'll meet someone at this trade expo who recognizes their hidden value.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Cool. Well, you do you. I'm certainly not gonna stop you.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: What about you, friend? Care to do some business?

response.speaker: Liben
response.text: Well, to be honest, I spent most of the ones in my inventory to purchase this batch of goods. The ones you see here are just for decoration.

response.speaker: Liben
response.text: But I'm confident that I can make a killing here, so I'll be sure to make another batch of Boxes o' Marvels should the opportunity arise later.

choices.text: Are you not in the Box o' Marvels business anymore?
